name: Ishiguro Akira
source: [spoiler]Ishiguro first met [url=/c125905]Nakazawa Yuuichi[/url] when they were little kids. Back then, she would constantly bully him at a playground. Despite treating him in such a manner, she considers him to be her first love (and only bullied him because she liked him). She has wanted to apologize ever since the day he moved. When the two of them are reunited years later at Asaya Gakuen, Ishiguro recognizes Nakazawa immediately. However, upset that her childhood crush doesn't recognize her, she begins to bully him again.[/spoiler]
